execution_note: Invented scenarios manually walked through the canonical records. A pass means the library records support the expected analysis and prevent the listed unsupported conclusions; this is not a software benchmark or a legal outcome prediction.

tests.title: Condition confused with a promise
tests.input: Clause: “Provider will deliver the report only if Client has paid all fees.” No separate payment clause is supplied.
issues_that_should_be_detected: The provider’s delivery duty appears conditional; the clause does not itself state a client promise to pay. Identify both the condition and the alleged payment obligation.
conclusions_that_must_not_be_asserted: Client breached a payment promise; provider may refuse delivery under governing law; the condition is enforceable.
expected_next_steps: Ask whether Client has a separate payment covenant, specify what counts as payment and when, and verify consequences under governing law.

run_result.method: manual rule-by-rule dry run against the named canonical records on 2026-09-28; no software harness
detected_issues: The provider’s delivery duty appears conditional; the clause does not itself state a client promise to pay. Identify both the condition and the alleged payment obligation.
unsupported_conclusions_withheld: Client breached a payment promise; provider may refuse delivery under governing law; the condition is enforceable.

tests.title: Ambiguity requires a commercial choice
tests.input: Clause: “Consultant may use the work product for internal and other business purposes.” Parties have not defined “other business purposes.”
issues_that_should_be_detected: “Other business purposes” has multiple plausible scopes and may change use rights; selecting one is a business choice.
conclusions_that_must_not_be_asserted: The phrase is narrow, customary, or limited to a specific use.
expected_next_steps: Ask which entities, projects, customers, and commercial uses are intended; show options and affected rights.

run_result.method: manual rule-by-rule dry run against the named canonical records on 2026-09-28; no software harness
detected_issues: “Other business purposes” has multiple plausible scopes and may change use rights; selecting one is a business choice.
unsupported_conclusions_withheld: The phrase is narrow, customary, or limited to a specific use.

tests.title: Definition expands composition-only deal
tests.input: A composition-only agreement defines “Work” to include compositions, master recordings, stems, DAW sessions, artwork, artist branding, and all future materials.
issues_that_should_be_detected: The definition expands the transaction beyond composition; identify each unrelated asset and the rights that the definition may reach.
conclusions_that_must_not_be_asserted: Payment or the label “work made for hire” alone resolves ownership.
expected_next_steps: Confirm covered assets and ownership/licensing intent item by item; route copyright questions to current authority/counsel.

run_result.method: manual rule-by-rule dry run against the named canonical records on 2026-09-28; no software harness
detected_issues: The definition expands the transaction beyond composition; identify each unrelated asset and the rights that the definition may reach.
unsupported_conclusions_withheld: Payment or the label “work made for hire” alone resolves ownership.

tests.title: Liability cap conflicts with another risk clause
tests.input: One section caps all liability at fees paid; another requires unlimited indemnity for third-party claims and does not address whether the cap applies.
issues_that_should_be_detected: Potential interaction or conflict between cap and indemnity; identify claim types, procedures, exclusions, and the text controlling each.
conclusions_that_must_not_be_asserted: The cap necessarily applies to every indemnity or no indemnity is capped.
expected_next_steps: Compare exact clauses and defined terms; ask which allocation was agreed; verify legal effect if needed.

unsupported_conclusions_withheld: The cap necessarily applies to every indemnity or no indemnity is capped.

tests.title: Plain-language rewrite must preserve an exception

conclusions_that_must_not_be_asserted: The rewrite is neutral or equivalent.
expected_next_steps: Restore the exception or obtain an explicit business/legal instruction to change it.

tests.title: Unfavorable but clear term
